title: What stangent-point-picker returns (Phase 3, D70)
description: Up to 5 reference pages a ticket is about, chosen from page titles only, each with a sentence quoted word for word from the ticket. Code checks every page exists and every quote is in the ticket.

page.description: A page id from the list, copied exactly.

quote.description: Words from the ticket, exactly as written there (at least 4 words, or a whole line), that say why.
